title: INVT GD170-PV Series Solar Water Pump VFD Inverter
body_html:
GD170-PV Series Solar Water Pump VFD

The GD170-PV Series is a high-performance solar water pump VFD designed for efficient solar pumping applications. With enhanced usability, optimized performance, and an extended voltage and power range, it supports both single-phase and three-phase pumps, making it a reliable solution for a wide range of solar water pumping needs.

Key Features

Comprehensive Voltage & Power Range

Power range from 5kw to 45kW, suitable for residential, agricultural, and industrial solar pumping systems.

Easy Installation & Operation

  • Direct connection to photovoltaic (PV) panels
  • No complicated parameter settings required
  • Automatic startup when powered on

Ensures quick setup and user-friendly operation.

Advanced Protection Mechanisms

Equipped with:

  • PV over-voltage protection
  • Reverse polarity alarm
  • Over-temperature derating

These features help improve safety, reliability, and product lifespan.

High-Efficiency MPPT Algorithm

Advanced MPPT technology delivers up to 99% solar power tracking efficiency, maximizing solar energy utilization and pump performance.

Boost Module for Low Voltage

Models 2.2kW and below support an optional boost module that:

  • Enhances low-voltage operation
  • Reduces solar panel quantity requirements
  • Lowers overall system cost

GPRS Remote Monitoring

Optional GPRS module support enables:

  • Real-time monitoring
  • Remote access via mobile app or computer
  • Convenient system management

AC/DC Auto Switching

Automatically switches between:

  • PV DC input
  • Grid AC input

Ensuring uninterrupted 24/7 operation.

IP54 Protection Option

Supports IP54 cabinet solutions for enhanced durability and reliable operation in harsh environments.

Shopify Product Description

GD170-PV Series Solar Water Pump VFD

Boost your solar water pumping system with the powerful and intelligent GD170-PV Series Solar Pump Inverter. Designed for maximum efficiency and reliability, the GD170-PV supports a wide voltage and power range, making it suitable for agricultural, residential, and industrial water pumping applications.

✅ Key Benefits

  • Supports Single Phase & Three Phase Pumps
  • Wide power range from 0.4kW to 110kW
  • Direct solar panel connection without complex settings
  • Advanced 99% efficiency MPPT technology
  • Automatic AC/DC switching for continuous operation
  • Built-in safety protections for long-lasting performance
  • Optional GPRS remote monitoring
  • IP54 protection option for outdoor environments

⚡ Smart Solar Pumping Solution

The GD170-PV automatically optimizes solar energy usage to deliver stable pump performance throughout the day. Its intelligent MPPT algorithm ensures maximum power extraction from solar panels, helping reduce electricity costs and improve water pumping efficiency.

🔒 Reliable Protection Features

The inverter includes multiple protection functions such as:

  • Over-voltage protection
  • Reverse polarity alarm
  • Over-temperature protection

These features enhance system safety and ensure dependable operation in tough conditions.

🌞 Ideal Applications

  • Agricultural irrigation
  • Tube well systems
  • Livestock water supply
  • Farmhouses
  • Remote area water pumping
  • Industrial water management

📱 Optional Remote Monitoring

Monitor and manage your solar pumping system anytime using the optional GPRS module through your mobile phone or computer.
